entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:1
segments: ¶"The priests, the Levites-all the tribe of Levi-shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel; they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and His portion.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:2
segments: "Therefore they shall have no inheritance among their brethren; the LORD is their inheritance, as He said to them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:3
segments: "And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether [it is] bull or sheep: they shall give to the priest the shoulder, the cheeks, and the stomach.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:4
segments: "The firstfruits of your grain and your new wine and your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep, you shall give him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:5
segments: "For the LORD your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons forever.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:6
segments: "So if a Levite comes from any of your gates, from where he dwells among all Israel, and comes with all the desire of his mind to the place which the LORD chooses,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:7
segments: "then he may serve in the name of the LORD his God as all his brethren the Levites [do], who stand there before the LORD.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:8
segments: "They shall have equal portions to eat, besides what comes from the sale of his inheritance.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:9
segments: ¶"When you come into the land which the LORD your God is giving you, you shall not learn to follow the abominations of those nations.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:10
segments: "There shall not be found among you [anyone] who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire, [or one] who practices witchcraft, [or] a soothsayer, or one who interprets omens, or a sorcerer,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:11
segments: "or one who conjures spells, or a medium, or a spiritist, or one who calls up the dead.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:12
segments: "For all who do these things [are] an abomination to the LORD, and because of these abominations the LORD your God drives them out from before you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:13
segments: "You shall be blameless before the LORD your God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:14
segments: "For these nations which you will dispossess listened to soothsayers and diviners; but as for you, the LORD your God has not appointed such for you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:15
segments: ¶"The LORD your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from your midst, from your brethren. Him you shall hear,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:16
segments: "according to all you desired of the LORD your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, 'Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, nor let me see this great fire anymore, lest I die.'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:17
segments: "And the LORD said to me: 'What they have spoken is good.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:18
segments: 'I will raise up for them a Prophet like you from among their brethren, and will put My words in His mouth, and He shall speak to them all that I command Him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:19
segments: 'And it shall be [that] whoever will not hear My words, which He speaks in My name, I will require [it] of him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:20
segments: 'But the prophet who presumes to speak a word in My name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:21
segments: "And if you say in your heart, 'How shall we know the word which the LORD has not spoken?' -

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:22
segments: "when a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD, if the thing does not happen or come to pass, that [is] the thing which the LORD has not spoken; the prophet has spoken it presumptuously; you shall not be afraid of him.
